title: matterbox configuration
description: User configuration for the matterbox Mattermost TUI (~/.config/matterbox/config.yaml). A missing or partial file is fine; matterbox fills in defaults.

server_url.description: Mattermost base URL (https://...). The placeholder https://mattermost.example.com counts as "not configured yet".

reactions.description: Emoji shortcodes shown in the reaction picker (R on a message). Names match Mattermost's shortcodes (no colons).

team_order.description: Preferred left-to-right ordering of team tabs, by team URL name (or display name; case-insensitive). Teams not listed are appended alphabetically. Reorder in-app with < / >.

mark_read_delay_seconds.description: How long a channel must stay open before it's marked read (default 5). 0 marks read immediately on open.

group_message_seconds.description: Collapse the name+time header on consecutive messages from the same person sent within this many seconds of each other (default 120). 0 keeps a header on every message.

collapse_long_messages.description: Fold a message taller than this many wrapped rows down to a preview plus a "… N more lines" footer (default 12; press z to expand). 0 disables folding.

collapse_preview_lines.description: How many leading rows a folded message keeps as its preview (default: two-thirds of collapse_long_messages). Clamped to 1…collapse_long_messages; ignored when folding is off.

custom_status.description: Show DM partners' custom statuses — emoji + text — in the header and sidebar (default true). false shows presence dots only.

date_separators.description: Draw a labelled rule ("Today", "Yesterday", or a full date) above the first message of each local calendar day (default true).

mouse.description: Enable mouse support: wheel-scroll, click a tab/channel/message to switch or select, drag to select text (default true). false keeps the terminal's native click-drag copy.

attach_on_drop.description: Attach a file dragged onto the terminal (default true). Terminals deliver a drop by pasting the file's path, so this is a heuristic: a paste that is nothing but existing absolute file paths is attached instead of typed into the composer. false pastes such paths as plain text.

download_dir.description: Where the download-attachment key (s on a message) saves files (default ~/Downloads). A leading ~ is expanded; the directory is created on first download.

sql_tab.description: Show the read-only SQL tab — a query editor over your local message cache whose rows render as chat messages (default false, hidden).

feed_show_muted.description: Include muted channels in the unread feed and its tab badge (default false — muting opts a channel out of the feed). Only the startup state: M on the Feed tab toggles it for the session.

kaomoji_options.description: Extra entries for the TUI's /kaomoji picker, listed after the built-in set.

emoji_images.description: Render custom (server) emoji as inline images via the Kitty graphics protocol. "auto" (default) enables them on a Kitty/Ghostty truecolor terminal outside tmux; "off" keeps literal :name: text. Unicode emoji are unaffected.

image_thumbnails.description: Draw image attachments as inline thumbnails in the transcript, so an image is visible without pressing space for the full-size preview. "off" (default) shows only the filename line; "auto" draws thumbnails wherever emoji_images works (same Kitty-graphics terminal gate). Space still opens the full preview either way.

file_previews.description: Preview the attachments that are text rather than pixels: the first lines of a log, diff, JSON or source file, syntax-highlighted, and a CSV/TSV drawn as a box table, above the file's own chip. "auto" (default) draws them; "off" leaves every such file as a plain chip. Needs no terminal graphics support. Only files under 2MB are fetched, and only when they scroll near the viewport.

image_click.description: What a mouse click on a rendered inline thumbnail does (needs image_thumbnails: auto). "preview" (default) opens the in-app full-size preview (same as space); "open" hands it to the OS/browser (same as o); "download" saves it to download_dir (same as s for attachments); "off" leaves the click as a plain message select. Only the thumbnail cells are clickable — not the filename chip or the rest of the message.

code_theme.description: Colour scheme for syntax-highlighting fenced code blocks. Any chroma style name plus the bundled everforest-dark. An unknown name falls back to the default; NO_COLOR disables code colour.

rules.description: Per-message automation for `matterbox listen`. Each rule has a match (conditions, ANDed) and actions (run in order). With no rules the daemon uses a built-in notify rule from the listen options. Full reference in docs/rules.md.

stringList.description: A single value or a list of values (match any).

stringOrList.description: A single key/chord, a list of them, or an empty list / "none" / null to unbind.

summary.description: The '> Summarize' command (ctrl+k): sends a transcript to an OpenAI-compatible chat server and shows the model's summary.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server; the client appends /v1/chat/completions.

api_key.description: Optional Bearer token sent in the Authorization header. Not needed for a local server.

model.description: Model id sent in the request. Run `curl <endpoint>/v1/models` to see what your server has loaded.

prompt.description: System prompt prepended to the transcript. The reader's @username is appended at request time.

aiSearch.description: Agentic search on the Search tab (a query ending in '?'). Reuses the summary endpoint+model.

prompt.description: System prompt that frames the search agent (how to use tools, when to stop, never answer from its own knowledge).

max_steps.description: Caps how many tool-call rounds the agent may take before it must answer (default 32).

timeout_minutes.description: Bounds the whole agentic run, all tool rounds together (default 4). Raise for a slow server or high max_steps.

embeddings.description: Semantic search. A SEPARATE OpenAI-compatible server from summary (its own port + an embedding model loaded with --embeddings; see scripts/llama-embeddings.sh).

endpoint.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible embeddings server; the client appends /v1/embeddings.

api_key.description: Optional Bearer token (not needed for a local server).

model.description: Embedding model id sent in each request.

dim.description: Truncate each vector (Matryoshka) to this many dimensions before storing, then renormalise (default 256). 0 keeps the model's native dimensionality.

auto_index.description: Enable the TUI's background indexer, embedding not-yet-embedded messages while you use the app (default true). false embeds only via `matterbox embed`.

search.description: Ranking for the Search tab and AI search.

recency_half_life_days.description: Halves a match's relevance weight per this many days of age (default 90). Lower = stronger recency bias.

nav_modifier.description: Modifier for arrow-key team/channel navigation. "none" turns arrow-nav off (freeing ctrl+←/→ for the composer). On macOS ctrl+arrows clash with Mission Control — try shift, or super on a Kitty-protocol terminal.

vim_nav.description: When the ctrl+h/j/k/l vim keys switch team/channel: "global" (default, from anywhere incl. while typing), "reading" (only outside text inputs, freeing ctrl+h/ctrl+k for composer editing), or "off".

ctrl_arrow_nav.description: Superseded boolean toggle kept only for pre-nav_modifier configs; false migrates to nav_modifier: none. Prefer nav_modifier.

bindings.description: Rebind individual actions by id, e.g. {compose: [i, a], delete_post: shift+d}. Value is a single key or a list; an empty list or "none" unbinds. Jump actions: goto_team, goto_dm, goto_feed, search_here, search_all.

animations.description: Optional motion effects, off-able if distracting.

custom_emoji.description: Animate GIF custom (server) emoji in place (default true). No effect unless emoji_images renders custom emoji as images.

image_preview.description: Animate GIFs in the space-to-preview image modal (default true). false shows the first frame only.

inline_images.description: Animate GIF attachments drawn as inline thumbnails (default true), and only while they are on screen. No effect unless image_thumbnails is auto. false shows the first frame only.

native_animation.description: Experimental (default false): play custom emoji, inline thumbnails, and the preview modal via the Kitty graphics protocol's native animation frames (a=f/a=a) instead of client-side re-transmission on a timer, so the terminal itself times and loops the frames. In a binary built with the `video` tag it also plays mp4/webm/mov/webp video — inline thumbnails as short looping previews, and the space-to-preview modal streams the whole clip. Needs animation-frame support beyond the base graphics protocol most Kitty-class terminals implement.

native_gif_protocol.description: Deprecated former name for native_animation. Still read for backward compatibility; migrated to native_animation on next config write. Prefer native_animation.

giphy.description: Expand a pasted Giphy link into an inline ![alt](url) image in the composer.

api_key.description: Giphy API key (https://developers.giphy.com, or the GIPHY_API_KEY env var). Optional: without it a link still expands offline, but the alt text comes from the URL slug rather than the GIF's real title.

rendition.description: Which Giphy size to post. downsized / downsized_medium need api_key; original can be several MB.

bot_token.description: Bot token from @BotFather. Empty disables delivery (the daemon still keeps the cache warm).

chat_id.description: Destination: a numeric chat id (message the bot, then read it from getUpdates) or an @channelusername.

notify_on_mention.description: Forward a notification when you're directly @mentioned or sent a DM (default true). false runs the daemon as a cache-warmer only.

summarize.description: Send an LLM summary of the surrounding conversation (default true, via the summary endpoint+model, falling back to raw text when it's down) instead of the bare message.

notify_prompt.description: System prompt for the notification summary. The reader's @username and the message source are appended at request time.

respect_mutes.description: Skip notifications for channels you've muted in Mattermost (default true).

respect_dnd.description: Skip notifications while your Mattermost status is Do Not Disturb (default true). Uses status_change websocket events; urgent notify actions still bypass.

quiet_hours.description: Suppress notifications during a daily window, "HH:MM-HH:MM" local time (may wrap past midnight, e.g. "22:00-08:00"). Empty = always on; messages are still cached.

two_way.description: Enable replying from Telegram and the /search /unread /digest commands (default true; needs telegram.chat_id). false for notify-only.

notify_dms.description: Also forward direct-message channels (default false, so a DM you're actively reading stays quiet). true restores the original behaviour.

notify_delay_seconds.description: Wait this long before sending, then re-check the server's read state — if any client marked the channel read during the window the notification is suppressed (default 60). 0 delivers immediately with no read-check.

jira.description: The Jira issue side panel. Press v on a message naming a Jira issue to fetch it from Jira Cloud and view it inline. Empty base_url/email/api_token disables the panel.

base_url.description: Instance root, e.g. https://your-instance.atlassian.net. Also used to recognise /browse/KEY links.

email.description: Atlassian account email — the username half of the Cloud Basic-auth pair.

api_token.description: Atlassian API token (id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens). The JIRA_API_TOKEN env var overrides this.

projects.description: Allowlist of project keys (e.g. ["ABC", "PROJ"]) whose bare ids (ABC-123) open the panel. Empty means only full /browse/KEY links are detected, so look-alikes like "UTF-8" never trigger.

story_points_field.description: Pins the story-points custom-field id (e.g. customfield_10016). Empty auto-detects it from the instance's field metadata.

gitlab.description: The GitLab merge-request side panel. Press v on a message linking a merge request to view it inline. Empty base_url (with no usable token) disables the panel.

base_url.description: Instance root, e.g. https://git.example.com. Also used to recognise /-/merge_requests/N links.

token.description: Personal or project access token (read_api to view; api to approve/merge). Empty falls back to the GITLAB_TOKEN env var, then to an existing glab CLI login for the host.

github.description: The GitHub issue / pull-request side panel. Press v on a message naming a GitHub issue or pull request to view it inline. Public repositories are readable without a token (anonymous, 60 requests/hour); a token adds private repos, approve/merge, and inline badges.

base_url.description: Instance root, e.g. https://github.com or https://ghe.example.com. Also used to recognize issue / pull URLs that point at this instance.

token.description: Optional personal access token. When unset, falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN (env overrides config, like GitLab), then an existing gh CLI login for the host, then optional matterbox OAuth from `matterbox github login`.

client_id.description: OAuth application's client_id for optional device-flow login (`matterbox github login`). Not needed when using a PAT or gh CLI token.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes for `matterbox github login`. Default ["public_repo", "repo:status"] covers public read + commit statuses without a broad private-repo write grant.

telemetry.description: Anonymous usage telemetry and error reporting. Strictly opt-in: off unless enabled is true, and only the first-run setup wizard asks — an existing install is never prompted. See https://matterbox.work/docs/telemetry

enabled.description: Send anonymous usage telemetry and error reports (default false). Absent means the question was never asked, which is also off.

anonymous_id.description: Random id the reports are grouped by, minted when you opt in. Not derived from your account, server or machine; delete it to become a new, unrelated user.

updateCheck.description: The daily check for a newer matterbox. On by default, unlike telemetry: the request carries no version, no platform and no identifier and the comparison happens on your machine, so it reports nothing about you. Nothing is ever installed without `matterbox upgrade`.

enabled.description: Check https://matterbox.work/latest.json once a day and mention it when a newer release exists (default true). `matterbox upgrade` still works with this off.

languageTool.description: Composer grammar/spell check (off by default). While you type, the draft is checked against a LanguageTool server and mistakes are underlined in place (alt+g opens suggestions).

enabled.description: Turn the composer grammar/spell check on (default false).

server_url.description: LanguageTool API /v2 root; the check endpoint is this + /check.

language.description: Checking language code, or "auto" (default) to let the server detect it per message.

picky.description: Enable LanguageTool's "picky" level — stricter style, typography and grammar rules (default false).

rule.description: One rule for the `matterbox listen` daemon: a match plus ordered actions.

name.description: Labels the rule in the daemon log (optional).

stop.description: Halt evaluation of later rules once this one matches.

actions.description: Actions run in order when the match passes.

on.description: Events the rule reacts to: message (default), edit, delete, reaction, reaction_removed, or schedule. A single value or a list.

ruleMatch.description: A rule's conditions; all set conditions must hold (AND). An empty match matches every non-system, non-empty post.

channel.description: Case-insensitive glob (*, ?) over the channel's display name, or an exact channel id. A single value or a list (match any).

team.description: Case-insensitive glob over the team's URL name (the slug, e.g. "core"), or an exact team id. A single value or a list (match any). A DM carries no team.

author.description: Username (no leading @), case-insensitive. A single value or a list (match any).

message.description: RE2 regexp over the body (prefix (?i) for case-insensitive).

mention.description: Require that you were directly named (@you).

dm.description: When set, require a direct message (true) or a channel (false).

from_me.description: When set, require the post be your own (true) or someone else's (false). `from_me: false` keeps an exec/webhook/react rule from firing on your own messages.

is_thread.description: When set, require a thread reply (true) or a root post (false).

viewing.description: When set, require that you are (true) or are not (false) looking at the post's channel — a matterbox TUI on this machine has it open and its terminal has focus. `viewing: false` keeps a notification rule quiet about the conversation you're already reading.

not.description: Inverts a nested match: the rule fires only when the post does NOT satisfy it.

state.description: Match against the persistent ledger (the state_* actions). A single condition or a list (all ANDed).

emoji.description: Reaction shortcode (no colons) as a case-insensitive glob or exact name. Needs `on: reaction`. A single value or a list.

reactor.description: Username (no @) whose reaction fires the rule. On a reaction trigger author/from_me still describe the post's writer. A single value or a list.

channel_type.description: Conversation kind: public, private, dm, or group. A single value or a list.

from_bot.description: Require the post come from a bot or incoming webhook (true) or from a person (false).

ruleFrequency.description: Rolling-window gate: the actions run only once `count` matches accumulate within `within`.

count.description: How many matches within the window fire the rule (>= 1).

within.description: Window length as a Go duration ("10m", "1h30m").

ruleCooldown.description: Minimum-interval gate: fires at most once per interval. Persisted, so it survives a restart — the general form of "once a day/week".

every.description: Minimum time between firings as a Go duration ("48h", "168h").

ruleState.description: One condition on a ledger key.

exists.description: Require the key be present (true) or absent (false).

eq.description: The stored value equals this (compared as a string).

ne.description: The stored value differs from this (compared as a string).

gt.description: The stored value, as a number, is greater than this.

gte.description: The stored value, as a number, is >= this.

lt.description: The stored value, as a number, is less than this.

lte.description: The stored value, as a number, is <= this.

ruleAction.description: One action. `type` is required; the remaining fields are read per type.

summarize.description: (notify) Override listen.summarize for this rule only.

urgent.description: (notify) Deliver even during quiet hours / for muted channels.

chat_id.description: (notify) Override the destination Telegram chat for this rule.

command.description: (exec) The argv; the post is piped to stdin as JSON and its fields exported as MATTERBOX_* env vars.

url.description: (webhook) Receives the post envelope as a JSON POST body.

headers.description: (webhook) Extra request headers; values are expanded from the daemon's environment ($TOKEN) so secrets stay out of the config.

emoji.description: (react) The Mattermost emoji shortcode to add (no colons).

text.description: (log) The log line prefix, or (send) the message body — a text/template over the post.

channel.description: (send) The target channel — "team/channel" or "@user". Empty posts into the channel the triggering message arrived in.

thread.description: (send) Post as a reply in the triggering post's thread instead of a new top-level post. Ignored when channel is set.

key.description: (state_set/state_incr/state_del) The ledger key, a text/template over the post (e.g. "failures:{{ .author }}").

value.description: (state_set) The value to store, a text/template over the post and current state (e.g. "{{ .create_at }}").

by.description: (state_incr) The amount to add; omitted means 1 (negative decrements).

ruleSchedule.description: Timer for an `on: schedule` rule. Set exactly one of cron / every.

cron.description: Five-field crontab expression in local time, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5" (09:00 on weekdays).

every.description: Interval between firings ("30m", "6h"); first fires one interval after startup, and the last firing survives a restart.

ruleTime.description: Restrict a rule to a window of the local clock and/or certain weekdays.

after.description: Inclusive start of the window, HH:MM local.

before.description: Exclusive end, HH:MM local. Earlier than after wraps midnight.

days.description: Weekdays the rule may fire on: mon..sun (or 0-7). A single value or a list.
